intent: A toast: a dark pill with a leading icon + message and one or two stacked action buttons. Announced politely to assistive tech.
guidance: Keep the message to one line of essential, non-blocking information — the toast is announced politely and never steals focus, so it must not be the sole home of anything critical. Give it at most two actions; a second stacks below the first with a divider. The pill is deliberately dark so it reads on any surface — don't recolor it to match a light panel.

anatomy.description: 24px glyph slot; defaults to the component diamond. Pass a contextual icon so the toast matches how the subject is shown elsewhere.
The polite live-region text that assistive tech announces on appearance.
Vertical rule separating the message from the action column.
One or two stacked CTA buttons, outside the live region so their labels aren't announced.

use_when: A transient, non-blocking message with optional actions (undo, view, retry).
dont_use_when: A blocking confirmation — use a dialog.
A persistent inline status — use inline text.

slots.icon: Leading glyph (defaults to the component diamond); pass a contextual icon to match how the subject is shown elsewhere.

tokens.note: Deliberately a dark pill that reads on any surface — its dark background and separators now bind to the theme-independent overlay tokens (--color-bg-overlay / --color-border-overlay), so it is fully token-bound.

a11y.role: status (polite live region — announced without stealing focus). Scoped to the icon+message content region, not the whole toast, so the CTA labels stay out of the announcement.
a11y.actions: each CTA is a <button> with a visible label, outside the live region.

code.example: <Notification message="Media added" actions={[{ label: 'Undo', onClick: undo }]} />
